existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: No local hard R4-to-R6 validation break was found for `VisionPrescription`. The main migration concerns are R6-only request linkage (`basedOn`, `groupIdentifier`), R6-only urgency (`priority`), and lossless R6-to-R4 conversion. Confidence is high for computable StructureDefinition differences but lower for rationale because official diff/narrative pages were not available locally.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration from R4 to R6 is structurally straightforward for existing local elements: no required R4 field was removed, no shared cardinality was tightened, and no shared type or reference target was narrowed. Migration from R6 back to R4 needs explicit handling for new optional request-pattern fields. `priority` should not be silently dropped when it carries `urgent`, `asap`, or `stat`; `basedOn` and `groupIdentifier` should be preserved through extensions, companion artifacts, or documented loss if round-tripping matters.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for element presence, cardinality, types, flags, and bindings because the local R4/R6 StructureDefinitions and local CodeSystems were compared directly. Confidence is medium for design intent and prevalence because official narrative diffs and real-world usage data were not available. Terminology confidence is high for the required local code systems inspected, but formal ValueSet expansions were not present.
